entries.en:
Casts a ball of ice which damages the target 
with a chance of impairing their movement 
speed or freezing them.
entries.zh-TW: 發射冰球造成傷害，並有機率降低目標移速或將其冰凍。
entries.pt-BR: Lança uma esfera de gelo que causa dano e pode reduzir a velocidade do alvo ou congelá-lo.
aliases:
Casts a ball of ice which damages the target 
with a chance of impairing their movement 
speed or freezing them.

entries.en:
A spell that creates a thunder storm around the
caster causing a shock on monsters into a
state of confusion.
entries.zh-TW: 在施法者周圍製造雷暴，電擊怪物並使其混亂。
entries.pt-BR: Cria uma tempestade de raios ao redor do conjurador, eletrocutando e confundindo monstros.
aliases:
A spell that creates a thunder storm around the
caster causing a shock on monsters into a
state of confusion.

entries.en:
Creates a protective field around caster that
absorbs any damage taken.
entries.zh-TW: 在施法者周圍形成吸收傷害的防護場。
entries.pt-BR: Cria um campo protetor que absorve o dano recebido pelo conjurador.
aliases:
Creates a protective field around caster that
absorbs any damage taken.

entries.en:
Chance to kill any undead mob that meets the
level requirements in a single cast.
entries.zh-TW: 有機率一次消滅符合等級限制的亡靈怪物。
entries.pt-BR: Pode eliminar com uma conjuração um monstro morto-vivo que cumpra o requisito de nível.
aliases:
Chance to kill any undead mob that meets the
level requirements in a single cast.

entries.en:
Draws health from the victim to replenish the
casters own health.
entries.zh-TW: 吸取目標生命，恢復施法者的生命。
entries.pt-BR: Drena a vida da vítima para restaurar a do conjurador.
aliases:
Draws health from the victim to replenish the
casters own health.

entries.en:
Casts a powerful ice storm that circles the
enemy causing damage on rotation.
entries.zh-TW: 釋放強力冰風暴，環繞敵人並持續造成傷害。
entries.pt-BR: Cria uma poderosa tempestade de gelo que gira ao redor do inimigo, causando dano.
aliases:
Casts a powerful ice storm that circles the
enemy causing damage on rotation.

entries.en:
Casts a powerful column of fire that burns its
target.
entries.zh-TW: 釋放強力火柱灼燒目標。
entries.pt-BR: Lança uma poderosa coluna de fogo que queima o alvo.
aliases:
Casts a powerful column of fire that burns its
target.

entries.en:
Summons an indentical clone of the caster
which will aid with attacks.

entries.pt-BR: Invoca um clone idêntico ao conjurador para ajudar nos ataques.
aliases:
Summons an indentical clone of the caster
which will aid with attacks.

entries.en:
Creates a huge burst of fire damaging anything
in its range.

entries.pt-BR: Cria uma grande explosão de fogo que causa dano a tudo em seu alcance.
aliases:
Creates a huge burst of fire damaging anything
in its range.

entries.en:
The caster will summon a storm from the sky 
which drops shards of ice upon the target in a 
5x5 range.

entries.pt-BR: Invoca uma tempestade que derruba fragmentos de gelo numa área de 5x5 casas ao redor do alvo.
aliases:
The caster will summon a storm from the sky 
which drops shards of ice upon the target in a 
5x5 range.

entries.en:
Summons a magical eye allowing the caster to 
see his enemies weakness's.

see his enemies weakness's.

entries.en:
Caster summons a meteor storm from the sky 
which drops molten rock on the enemies in a

Caster summons a meteor storm from the sky 
which drops molten rock on the enemies in a 
5x5 range.

entries.en:
